title: Uniform Residential Loan Application

origin.publisher: Unknown (user upload on Scribd); generated by a lender's DocuTech document system on the Fannie Mae Form 1003 / Freddie Mac Form 65 (1/2021) template
origin.title: Uniform Residential Loan Application (Fannie Mae Form 1003 / Freddie Mac Form 65, effective 1/2021)
origin.clearance_note: A completed, e-signed loan application uploaded to Scribd, a user-upload site and not a publisher, so it was treated as a personal record. The operator downloaded it by hand on 2026-10-03 because Scribd blocks scripted downloads; the source of record is the ID-only Scribd URL. Every personal value was replaced before parsing (see redactions), and the operator reviewed the redacted pages before the ADE run. Before redaction the file's e-sign certification signature covered the whole file and its SHA-512 digest matched, so the content had not been altered after signing.

redactions.method: PyMuPDF redaction annotations (underlying text removed, stand-ins written in the original font and size), plus a page-scoped pass for values that also occur legitimately elsewhere; output verified by re-extracting text and scanning every decompressed object and stream.

notes: The request named no fields; its notes and the operator asked for impersonal ones only (loan amount, loan purpose, property value, occupancy, gross monthly income, checkboxes). Page 3's section 4a carries four of them in one block, so it tells one story: what is being borrowed, why, against what, and for what use. Loan amount is pinned to occurrence 3 (the 4a field; 0-2 are on page 8) and property value to occurrence 1 (the 4a field; occurrence 0 is the 3a real-estate row). Loan purpose and occupancy are radio-button selections and ground to their checked option. Gross monthly income (base and total) grounds ok but sits on page 1, so it could not join this overlay. The demographic boxes on page 6 were set to 'I do not wish to provide this information' during redaction and do not represent the borrower's original answers.
